Unbroken Tail Circuit.name: Unbroken Tail Circuit
Unbroken Tail Circuit.description: The user sustains coordinated tail braces, close blocks and footwork for five minutes while escorting people through a damaged building. Each turn they can steady one person within two meters against a stumble while keeping their own footing. The tail remains its normal length and cannot stop heavy rubble; afterward its base cramps and cannot bear weight until the user rests. Strain: severe.
